overall: The AG found the Pilgrim 1600 Acre Plan Team was not a public body because it was not within government, so it could not have violated the Open Meeting Law; the complaint was resolved with no order.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Pilgrim 1600 Acre Plan Team did not post notice of its meetings (public forums and visioning session).
allegations.key_passage: For the reasons stated above, we find that the Team was not a public body subject to the Open Meeting Law and therefore could not have violated the Open Meeting Law.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Team did not create or maintain minutes of its meetings.
allegations.key_passage: We must conclude that the Team was not a public body.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Team otherwise failed to comply with the Open Meeting Law; AG found the Team was a private consultant group, not within government.
allegations.key_passage: Consultancy of the kind provided by the Team to the Town is not an essentially governmental function.
